# Bath–Saltford proving fixture

This is a deliberately **synthetic, minimised** geographic fixture.  Its names
make the decision question legible; its linework is not a survey, proposed
scheme, current route condition, safety finding, legal-access finding, funding
case, or adopted B&NES/WECA design.

It represents the relationship that the prototype needs to test: a current
Bath–Bristol Railway Path/NCN-like inter-urban asset, an A4-like strategic
corridor, Saltford and a Bath-edge community, a secondary school and an
explicitly admitted Bath Spa University strategic education destination.  The
governed evidence files retain 2021-style OA/PWC population records and
versioned school/admission records.  They intentionally preserve unknown
condition, legal-access, cost and feasibility evidence rather than inferring
an advantage from route status.

The fixture's benchmark record is generated by its regression test.  It is a
small-area test baseline only; it makes no B&NES, WECA or hardware-performance
claim.
